evidence.section: 3.1 High temperature ductility and hot workability after annealing
evidence.quote: the high-temperature tensile plasticity of the alloy is improved significantly up to 41 %, increasing by nearly twofold after annealing at 973 K for 48 h.

These findings confirm that severe lattice distortion is widespread in the as-cast FCC solid solution and likely plays a key role in thermal metastability of the alloy by promoting structural instability during annealing and high-temperature processing.
Furthermore, we found that the ordered phases act as effective barriers to dislocation slip and promote the nucleation of nanoscale twins by generating favorable local stress concentrations.
